extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I attempted to demonstrate the issue rather than exclude it. (1) I checked whether any sentence in the report presents the 60.00% rate as a property of the complete planned set of 20 pools; none does — the target section and the selected result both restrict the claim to the 15 retained pools. (2) I recomputed the screening from inputs/data.csv: pools P04, P07, P10, P13, P17 have hydroperiod < 60 days (5 removed), leaving 15 retained, of which 9 (P01, P02, P05, P06, P09, P11, P14, P16, P19) have egg_mass_detected=yes, confirming 9/15 = 60.00% exactly as reported; note P10 has egg masses but is correctly excluded from both numerator and denominator, so there is no domain leakage in either direction. (3) I checked task alignment: the task mandates a retained-subset target, so the retained-subset denominator is not a mismatch but the required design. The issue class could not be demonstrated.
